skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics and advanced concepts of machine learning.
Proficiency in using Python for machine learning tasks.
Ability to apply supervised learning techniques such as regression and classification.
Ability to apply unsupervised learning techniques such as clustering and dimensionality reduction.
Understanding and application of neural networks and deep learning techniques.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Evaluation Techniques for Machine Learning Models
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to evaluate the performance of machine learning models using various techniques.
Ability to select appropriate models and tune parameters effectively.
Understanding and applying criteria to evaluate the performance of machine learning systems.
Develop skills in researching, analyzing, synthesizing, solving, and evaluating machine learning problems.
Demonstrate ability to work independently and in teams.
Show capability for self-directed learning and responsibility.
